items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: I took Sidney Devis' place in the Olympia band. Eddie Jackson playing the bass ball.

ctx.x: That's the man. The bloody man. Yeah, he's the only one that isn't... I took Sidney Devis' place in the Olympia band. Eddie Jackson playing the bass ball. Oh, yeah. I'll never forget that. I've been advertising a mule and wagon. Mule and wagon.
Well, we're talking about bass players. Who did you learn from or did you have lessons in the WPA business or what?
